items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I joined the Buccaneers, the band by the name of the Buccaneers. A fella by the name of Earl Anderson was the lead of the band. You know, played with them for a while

ctx.x: When I had the blue lamp I was playing music too then. I had the, I joined the Buccaneers, the band by the name of the Buccaneers. A fella by the name of Earl Anderson was the lead of the band. You know, played with them for a while and I began to get so much work. I was getting more work than he was behind me so the guy made me the manager of the band. And I still lived in for quite a while.
I don't even know that band, the Buccaneers. I don't remember that. You know, I don't know.
